species.tagline: The bird you see every day in estates and parks

tasks.title: Find the white patch
tasks.message: It has a white patch on the back of its head — that is how it got its name.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a light-vented bulbul. The white patch on its head makes it easy to spot.

tasks.title: Find the wings
tasks.message: Its wings are olive green, and it flies in short bouncy hops.
tasks.subtitle: A bulbul has olive-green wings. It does not fly high — it hops from tree to tree.

tasks.title: See the real bird
tasks.hint: Tap the photo on the right
tasks.message: On a real bulbul the white patch is very clear.
tasks.subtitle: This is a photo of a real bulbul. Drag the slider and find the white patch.

tasks.title: What it eats
tasks.message: It eats fruit and insects, so it needs trees to feed on.
tasks.subtitle: Bulbuls eat fruit and insects. More trees in the estate means more food. Thank you!
